source_scope: Europe PMC includes PubMed records. Independent E-utilities, Crossref and Unpaywall searches are deferred to benchmark expansion; no fabricated contact email.

query_templates.A: pair unqualified, then each of seven dimensions
query_templates.B: each disease AND union of dimension terms

dimension_terms.phenotype: phenotyp* OR "clinical features" OR manifestation* OR symptom*
dimension_terms.genetic: gene* OR variant* OR inherit* OR genotype*
dimension_terms.mechanism: pathway* OR mechanis* OR molecular OR pathogenesis
dimension_terms.therapeutic: treatment* OR therap* OR drug* OR intervention*
dimension_terms.natural_history: "natural history" OR progression OR onset OR survival
dimension_terms.diagnostic_confusability: "differential diagnosis" OR mimic* OR misdiagnos* OR distinguish*
dimension_terms.comorbidity: comorbid* OR "co-occur" OR association OR "risk of"

control_terms: distinguish* OR "differential diagnosis" OR unrelated OR distinct OR "no association" OR "negative association" OR reclassification OR "non-replication" OR "different mechanisms"
stopping: All templates run. Capped queries/citation pages are explicitly incomplete; budget exhaustion is NOT evidence saturation or a systematic-review stopping claim.
inclusion: Both exact canonical entities; substantive dimension evidence; identifiable population and model; compatible granularity. Human screening is required.
license_policy: Only explicit CC-BY or CC0 full-text body enters reusable text exports. NC, ND, SA, unspecified licenses require separate review. Metadata/abstracts never automatically imply permission for text training.
score_definitions: Exact section 10 of frozen rubric; ordinal 0..4, missing is null. No automated cooccurrence-to-score conversion.
primary_outcome: Audited dimension-specific ordinal evidence; no primary model claims in pilot.
secondary_outcome: Licensed document corpus and locator-based review queue.
controls: Search for explicit unrelated and related-but-distinct evidence; no absence-based negatives. No unobserved control sampling until body system/prevalence/coverage matching is available.

review.training_extraction: one extractor plus audit only after reliability threshold is met

aggregation.weight: quality_weight * extraction_confidence; cap each family at 12
aggregation.sensitivity: unweighted family median; range and MAD

splits.disease_held_out: 20% diseases hash-selected; mixed pairs quarantined; shared papers quarantined
splits.time: train <=2022; validation 2023; test >=2024; crossing study families quarantined
splits.status: provisional until family review and benchmark freeze

minimum_evidence: No primary claims below 100 held-out pairs/dimension and 50 examples/required group. Primary labels need reviewed families, verified mapping and controls.
known_limitations: Pairs seeded from prior literature induce selection bias.
Orphanet membership does not establish prevalence <1/2000 in every population.
Candidate passages are retrieval aids, not screening decisions or evidence labels.
Study-family assignments begin unresolved; no primary supervised export until reviewed.
